scope: Cutscene script s01; all supported END-terminated messages, including the Yorozuya opening, Otose and Catherine, the Shinsengumi encounter, Hijikata and Ayame. Unsupported read-only records remain unchanged.
notes: Unofficial fan translation of Gintama: Gintoki vs. Hijikata!? Kabukichou Gintama Dai Soudatsusen!! (Nintendo DS). I do not own Gintama or the original game. No affiliation, endorsement or permission from the rights holders is implied. Use only legally obtained ROMs; piracy is discouraged. See RIGHTS.md for rights and licensing limits.
Otsu’s abrupt word endings are deliberate jokes. Gin Tama terminology and the deliberate Shinichi misnaming are retained.
The Gin/kin exchange is a silver/gold pun that turns into a testicle joke. Gin is retained where the original repeats the first half of Gin Tama.
